scrapers.name: Arab Hub
scrapers.description: Arabic movies, series & anime in one scraper: FaselHD, TopCinema, ArabSeed, Laroza, 3isk, Anime4up, WitAnime with domain fallbacks (m3u8/mp4, 360p-1080p, ~20-35s)
scrapers.author: HMubaireek

scrapers.name: TorBox
scrapers.description: Plays files already in your TorBox library (torrents, usenet, web). Matches English, Arabic and transliterated titles (Al.Sada.Al.Afadel = السادة الأفاضل); links are fetched fresh at play time. Needs your TorBox API key in this plugin's settings.
scrapers.author: HMubaireek
